links.kind: Prospective structural calculation on one known allocation refusal; no closure run.

question: What exact allocation envelope does the frozen producer require for the accepted n47 random00 D4 seed at chunk sizes 1, 4096 and 60000?

claims.text: Border counts agree under independent enumeration directions; native-envelope bytes reproduce the frozen source formula, not measured RSS or minimum memory.

arms.description: Deterministic full-monomial enumeration on each retained map; no solver or checker rerun is attributed to this arm.
Independent enumeration direction: extend free degree-four monomials, deduplicate, test all deletions. Executed for every input.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic counts; no timing or stochastic comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Software controls verify the full-free monomial set has binomial(N,D+1) border coordinates; these are separate unit fixtures, not scientific arms.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Software controls verify an all-pivot seed has zero border coordinates and malformed seeds are rejected; no statistical null population.

primary.name: provisional lifted quotient coordinates
primary.definition: Seed quotient dimension plus number of degree-five monomials all of whose degree-four divisors are seed unit representatives.

secondary.name: native allocation envelope
secondary.definition: Sum of the five source payload terms, multiplied by 135 and integer divided by 100, plus 64 MiB. All three declared chunk sizes reported.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Write-once completed instance JSON; retry an interrupted profile only in a new run directory.

stopping_rules.rule: Profile the single frozen seed; retain rejection or completed result. No closure worker launch.

invalidation_rules: Malformed or hash-mismatched certificate yields no capacity inference.
Payload calculation alone never admits a frontier run.

decision_rule.text: Record exact coordinate counts for each well-formed triangular seed; use them only to select and implement a memory-accounted producer.
